{"name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl","version":"1.0","description":"Manages the revision control of UEFN projects: which provider each project uses, connecting to it, and installing
a project from it. Provider names are None, Lore and Perforce. Per-asset operations such as asset state, revision
history and changelists are in the engine's SourceControlToolset. Tools and script functions run on the subsystem
instance: get it with unreal.get_editor_subsystem(unreal.ValkyrieRevisionControl) in Python.","tools":[{"description":"Save every unsaved asset, then sync the connected project's files from revision control and reload the synced
assets, including the open level when one of its actors changed. Does not ask for confirmation.","name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl.SyncToRevision","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"revision":{"type":"string","description":"Optional revision to sync to, as reported by GetRevisionControlStatus or CheckIn. When empty, syncs to the latest revision; skips the sync when the provider reports that the project is already at the latest revision.","default":""}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Valor del resultado."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Switch the main project to a revision control provider and connect to it, as the Revision Control menu does.
Connecting a project to Lore for the first time also saves Lore as the default provider of every collaborator
on Content Service, and creates the project's repository when it has none; call CheckIn afterwards to upload the
project files as its initial revision. Every later switch is saved for this user only.","name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl.SetProjectRevisionControlProvider","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"provider":{"type":"string","description":"Provider to switch to: Lore or Perforce. None, or empty, disconnects the project from revision control for this user.","default":""}}},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"description":"Always null","type":"null"}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Relink a project whose local copy was lost to its Lore backup, as the project browser's "search for backup"
action does. The project then appears in the project browser as syncable from revision control.","name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl.RecoverProjectFromRevisionControl","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"projectId":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the project on Content Service."}},"required":["projectId"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"description":"Always null","type":"null"}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Open a project from its revision control as the main project, downloading it into a new folder first, as the
project browser does for a project that is not on this machine. The provider comes from the project's settings on
Content Service. Refused while a play-in-client session is connected, if the editor would warn about the project
change.","name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl.OpenProjectFromRevisionControl","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"projectId":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the project on Content Service."},"projectName":{"type":"string","description":"Name of the folder created inside ProjectLocation for the project."},"projectLocation":{"type":"string","description":"Absolute path of the folder that receives the project folder."},"branch":{"type":"string","description":"Optional Lore branch id to sync, the hexadecimal digest GetRevisionControlStatus reports as Branch for a project on that branch, not a branch name. When empty, syncs the project's default branch. Ignored by providers without branches.","default":""},"revision":{"type":"string","description":"Optional revision to sync, as reported by GetRevisionControlStatus or CheckIn; the latest revision of the branch when empty.","default":""},"bLoadLevel":{"type":"boolean","description":"Whether to load the project's level once it is open. Without a level, the editor shows an empty Untitled world, so load one before editing actors.","default":false},"forkId":{"type":"string","description":"Optional id of the fork the project opens against. When empty, the editor picks the fork from the command line, then the fork the project last used, then the editor's active fork.","default":""}},"required":["projectId","projectName","projectLocation"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Valor del resultado."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Describe the revision control state of the editor and of the main project.","name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl.GetRevisionControlStatus","inputSchema":{"type":"object"},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"title":"ValkyrieRevisionControlStatus","description":"The state; fields about the main project are empty or false when no project is open.","type":"object","properties":{"bProjectRevisionControlEnabled":{"type":"boolean","description":"Si el editor gestiona el control de versiones por proyecto. Se desactiva cuando se ha forzado un proveedor mediante -SCCProvider en
la línea de comandos o se ha desactivado el control de versiones por proyecto; en ese caso, se rechazan las herramientas de proyecto indicadas a continuación.","default":false},"activeProvider":{"type":"string","description":"Nombre del proveedor activo: Ninguno, Lore o Perforce","default":""},"bConnected":{"type":"boolean","description":"Si el proveedor activo está activado y conectado, de modo que se puedan registrar cambios y realizar sincronizaciones","default":false},"userProvider":{"type":"string","description":"Proveedor al que el editor de este usuario conecta el proyecto principal: la elección del propio usuario, guardada en este equipo, o
TeamProvider si el usuario nunca ha elegido uno. Vacío sin proyecto.","default":""},"teamProvider":{"type":"string","description":"Proveedor predeterminado del que parte cada colaborador, guardado en Content Service por el primer usuario que conectó el
proyecto principal a Lore o mediante el menú Control de versiones. Vacío cuando no se ha guardado ningún proveedor o no hay proyecto.","default":""},"bHasChangesToCheckIn":{"type":"boolean","description":"Si hay cambios locales pendientes de registrar; se desactiva cuando no hay conexión o el proveedor no puede determinarlo","default":false},"bHasChangesToSync":{"type":"boolean","description":"Si existe una revisión más reciente que sincronizar; se desactiva cuando no hay conexión o el proveedor no puede determinarlo","default":false},"branch":{"type":"string","description":"Rama en la que se encuentra la copia de trabajo del proyecto principal; solo conocida por Lore","default":""},"revision":{"type":"string","description":"Revisión en la que se encuentra la copia de trabajo del proyecto principal; solo se conoce en Lore","default":""}}}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}},{"description":"Save every unsaved asset, then check in every pending change of the connected project as one revision.
Does not ask for confirmation and does not open the check-in dialog.","name":"ValkyrieEditor.ValkyrieRevisionControl.CheckIn","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"description":{"type":"string","description":"Description of the revision."}},"required":["description"]},"outputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"returnValue":{"type":"string","description":"Valor del resultado."}},"required":["returnValue"]},"annotations":{"accessMode":"execute"}}]}
